label: Improved method, 2011 data, with North East Victoria's 2011 population corrected
description: 2011-improved (frozen) with one more correction to the data, error 8 of ERRATA.md: North East Vic (zone 22) carried Goulburn Broken's population, 204,651 to the person, and the infrastructure area derived from it. The module north-east-vic-population sets the zone to the ABS estimated resident population at 30 June 2011, 98,604, and its infrastructure to 72 km2 (non-agricultural land 3,034 km2, the remainder); Victoria's population, the sum of its regions in this tier, falls by the same 106,047. On this method the infrastructure area enters the capacity through reserve-pro-rata, so North East Vic's short-term capacity moves a little; every other zone is as in 2011-improved. 2011-improved stays as published.
